title: The failed-exit balance-truth tests drive only the thrown-error path; the exits that fail by returning false (V3 private not landed, unknown dex, routine pause) are never checked for failed-held marking, so the registered S1 that they skip it passes green

evidence.note: Test 1: the failure is escalatePrivateSell rejecting (a throw) on a V2 dex
Test 3: the paused 6th trigger returns false; the case asserts only that no submit happened, not that the position stays failed-held with a re-armed timer
V3 private not landed: return false without markExitFailedHeld or re-arm (AUD-EXIT-007)

sibling_sites_checked: Every exitEngine unit fixture uses a V2 dex (antiRugReason, exitInclusionLadder, noDoubleSellReconcile, opEnrichment, failedExitBalanceTruth, exitWorkerRealPath); none drives the V3 private-not-landed branch or the unknown-dex branch. noDoubleSellReconcile asserts failed-held marking on the inconclusive branch (correct).
severity_rationale: S2: the file claims the still-held failure keeps protection (an S1 stranded-position fix) but covers one of four failure exits; the registered S1 AUD-EXIT-007 is the uncovered rest.
recommendation: Phase 28: one case per false-returning branch of executeFullSell, each asserting the persisted state and the re-armed timer for a still-held position.
affected_cases: Test 1 (CANONICAL): a failed exit on a STILL-HELD position KEEPS anti-rug + persists exit_failed_held + re-arms the poll timer
Test 3: after N=5 consecutive ROUTINE failures, routine retries pause — a 6th routine trigger does NOT submit
escaped_regression: Today's code already escapes (AUD-EXIT-007): the V3 branch at src/exitEngine.ts:1022-1037 returns false without markExitFailedHeld after an anti-rug caller cleared the timer, and every case stays green.
